tasks.title: Build Kohakuyasha v0.1.0 local Windows foundation
tasks.result: Portable bootstrap, core, SQLite, tray, watchdog, Russian web UI, autostart, diagnostics and tests implemented.

tasks.title: Validate Kohakuyasha v0.1.2 on physical Windows
acceptance: Kohakuyasha.bat launches from a removable drive
Pinned portable Python downloads when no suitable system Python exists
Tray icon and asynchronous menu actions work
Browser opens the local UI and protected API works
Autostart works with Cyrillic/spaced paths and survives drive-letter change
Restart succeeds repeatedly without watchdog loop

tasks.title: Security and reliability hardening v0.1.1
tasks.result: Closed browser-origin attack surface, hardened runtime/bootstrap/restart/database/config/tray/UI, separated dev tests and expanded automated coverage to 17 tests.

tasks.title: Establish Windows and Linux CI baseline v0.1.2
tasks.result: Added GitHub Actions validation on Windows and Linux with pinned Python 3.13.16; CI exposed and fixed Windows SQLite handle locking and PowerShell 5.1 UTF-8 BOM compatibility. Final run passed on both platforms.
